fusions.name: Skewered in a Row
fusions.desc: Throws a skewer that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then runs on through 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Trussed for the Table
fusions.desc: Runs a trussing skewer through the target, dealing 26 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Share of the Spit
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. Its healing rises 1% for every 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Choicest Cut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
